stories.summary: A 70-year-old woman died at the Kanhangad District Hospital following a hernia surgery, prompting her family to file a complaint alleging medical negligence. The Hosdurg police registered a case of unnatural death and shifted the body to the Kannur Government Medical College Hospital for post-mortem examination. The deceased was identified as Madhavi of Chemmattamvayal.

stories.title: NPPA examines extending drug margin caps beyond cancer medicines to other therapies
stories.summary: The Centre is examining whether trade margin caps should be extended beyond cancer medicines to other high-cost and essential drugs, including antibiotics, diabetes and heart medicines, as well as biologics, while seeking to avoid disruptions to drug availability and hospital supplies, two government officials said.

stories.title: Punjab sends 4-doctor panel for director, health services post
stories.summary: With the term of the present director of health services (DHS), Suman Singh, ending on Tuesday, Punjab has sent a panel of four doctors for the post. Suman Singh, who has been serving for the past five years, received a one-year extension last year after reaching retirement age.

stories.title: Chinese doctors’ delegation visits Hyd to build medical ties
stories.summary: The visit was aimed to help the Chinese doctors understand India’s healthcare delivery system while facilitating exchanges in medical technology, research, treatment practices and traditional medicine, including traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) and acupuncture. “This is primarily an effort to promote friendship and exchange between the two countries through the medical profession.

stories.title: From slurred speech to an uneven smile: Doctor shares mini-stroke warning signs and when to call an ambulance
stories.summary: Slurred speech that clears up in minutes may still signal a mini-stroke. When someone briefly slurs their words and then starts speaking normally again, it is easy to chalk it up to tiredness , especially if they say they feel fine. But such a sudden change in speech can be a sign of stroke.

stories.title: Mumbais NSCI Faces FDA Crackdown As Inspectors Find Flies In Kitchen, Cockroaches Near Wash Basin; Food
stories.summary: Mumbai: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has said it has suspended the food licence of the National Sports Club of India (NSCI) in Mumbai for safety violations after inspectors found flies in the main kitchen and cockroaches in the wash basin area.

stories.title: Woman undergoes 3 procedures in 3 weeks after prolonged bleeding; doctor directed to pay Rs 2 lakh
stories.summary: A procedure intended to clear her uterus after a failed pregnancy was expected to end her ordeal. Instead, the woman continued bleeding for weeks, eventually requiring a third procedure and a blood transfusion at a hospital in another city. The case dates back to Oct 8, 2024, when Amrutha (name changed), a resident of Kalena Agrahara, visited Shree Krishna Clinic in JP Nagar 8th Phase for a pregnancy test.

stories.title: Maharashtra FDA commissioner warns against unlicensed sale of whey protein, misleading health claims
stories.summary: Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe on Monday (November 23, 2026) warned of stringent action against gym operators selling health supplements without requisite authorisation and manufacturers making misleading claims about their health benefits, following a State-wide compliance order aimed at regulating the manufacture, marketing and sale of nutraceutical products.

stories.title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds
stories.summary: The largest health board in Wales is still failing, with "fundamental weaknesses" in its governance and management, according to a new report. Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board (BCUHB) has been in special measures for around half its existence, with the latest period starting in 2023.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh extends Employees Health Scheme facilities to retired transport staff
stories.summary: The Andhra Pradesh Public Transport Department (APPTD) has advised its unit officers to step up awareness and facilitate enrolment of retired employees in the Employees Health Scheme (EHS), following the government’s permission to extend medical benefits to the staff who retired on or after January 1, 2020.

stories.title: Diabetes warning signs: Doctors explain 7 early symptoms young adults should not ignore
stories.summary: “Diabetes is no longer a health concern that people can afford to worry about only after crossing 40. Increasingly, young adults are also at risk, and the worrying part is that the early signs can easily be mistaken for everyday problems such as tiredness, stress or dehydration.

stories.title: Keep groceries fresh and cut down on waste: When to choose resealable pouches, refill packs or single-use packaging for everyday foods
stories.summary: The best packaging depends on the food and how you use it. Know which one suits each kind of food. Ever wondered how best to store the cereal you opened last week? You might reach for that box every morning, use a sachet of ketchup in one go or top up your coffee jar from a refill pouch.

stories.title: After 63 years of inception, first major overhaul for MCD-run hospital in East Delhi
stories.summary: Thank you for your feedback. Your feedback has been reported succesfully. × English (Original) हिंदी AI Translation After 63 years of operations, Swami Dayanand Hospital run by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) in East Delhi is set to get its first major infrastructure overhaul in two phases.

stories.title: Kannale brought back to Parappana Agrahara jail after hospital stay
stories.summary: Basavaraj Kannale, an accused in the KPSC recruitment scam, was brought back to Parappana Agrahara Central Prison after prison authorities found that he did not require inpatient treatment at Victoria Hospital, where he had been admitted citing severe knee pain. Kannale had approached the court seeking medical treatment, claiming that he was suffering from acute knee pain.

stories.title: Jipmer wants Health Ministry to regionalise staff recruitment process, speed up establishment of organ transplant centre
stories.summary: Regionalising staff recruitment and speeding up the process for establishing a multi-organ transplantation centre and an advanced trauma care unit were some of the key demands raised by the management of the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research during an internal review meeting chaired by the Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare J.

stories.title: Winter skincare mistakes: Dermatologist reveals why hot showers and harsh scrubs can leave skin dry and irritated
stories.summary: Cold weather, hot showers and harsh scrubbing can worsen winter dryness and irritation. Winter poses several challenges for your skin, from dry weather and low temperatures to pollution. Skin complaints are common at this time of year, but a few simple changes to your daily routine can help ease them.

stories.title: Lung health beyond smoking: The everyday risks we often overlook
stories.summary: Most Indian cities sit well above what the World Health Organization considers a safe level of particulate matter in the air, and this isn't some rare, localised problem. Most of the world's population lives with air that fails that same benchmark. You don't choose to breathe city air the way you choose to light a cigarette.

stories.title: Gynaecologist explains use of antibiotics during pregnancy, shares risk of self-medication
stories.summary: Dr Amber Aggrwal highlights the importance of taking antibiotics as advised by a doctor during pregnancy to treat infections if they arise. Women undergo significant physiological changes during pregnancy that can affect the immune system and make them prone to infections.

stories.title: Guidelines sought to define local bodies’ role in health services
stories.summary: The government has taken seriously a complaint by a medical officer seeking fresh guidelines to prevent local bodies from sidelining Health Department officials in the implementation of health programmes. The complaint, submitted by medical officer K. Prathibha, follows an incident in which polio drops were administered to children at a veterinary hospital at Changaliri near Mannarkkad.

stories.title: Expanded NCD survey in Andhra Pradesh to cover four additional health conditions
stories.summary: The Department of Health, Medical and Family Welfare has announced that health screenings being conducted in the State under the Non-Communicable Diseases (NCD) survey will be expanded to cover four additional health conditions — obesity, fatty liver disease, chronic respiratory conditions and mental health disorders. Until now, screening has been conducted for people aged 18 and above for five major health conditions — hypertension, diabetes, oral cancer, breast cancer and cervical cancer.

stories.title: Sooryavanshi, 15, breaks sixes record by scoring 204 off 53 balls
stories.summary: India's 15-year-old batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hit the most sixes ever recorded in a senior men's innings in blazing 204 from 53 balls for India A against the United Arab Emirates. While almost halving the record for the fastest double-century in List A cricket, Sooryavanshi hit 28 sixes and seven fours in the Asia Cup Rising Stars competition - easily breaking Chad Bowes' previous record of 103 balls from 2024 .

stories.title: USA joint bid and UK confirmed as 2031 and 2035 FIFA Women's World Cup hosts
stories.summary: FIFA on Monday (November 23, 2026) confirmed that a joint bid led by the United States will host the expanded, 48-team Women's World Cup in 2031, while the United Kingdom will host the following edition in 2035.

stories.title: Sooryavanshi smashes fastest List A double hundred
stories.summary: India’s teenage batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi etched his name in the history books on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), shattering the world record for the fastest double hundred in List A cricket with a 52-ball blitz against the UAE in the Rising Stars Asia Cup. Sooryavanshi surpassed the record held by Chad Bowes, who scored a 200 off 103 balls for Canterbury against Otago in the Ford Trophy in 2024.

stories.title: Ben Stokes enters IPL 2027 auction at maximum base price
stories.summary: Asia Cup-winning stars Aaryavir Sehwag and Mohit Ulva have registered for the IPL 2027 auction after their impressive performances in the tournament, as per reports from Cricbuzz . Both youngsters were part of India's title-winning campaign in Oman, where the team defeated Pakistan by one wicket in a thrilling final.

stories.title: Jeakson’s late strike keeps East Bengal alive in Asia
stories.summary: It wasn’t till the 87th minute that East Bengal’s night turned from grim to a fairy tale. With Jordan’s World Cup players on the roster, Al Hussein had created chance after chance and hit the framework four times. On other occasions, Phurba Lachenpa kept East Bengal in the game they had to win to stay alive in Asian Champions League 2.

stories.title: 'I do feel pressure': Vaibhav Sooryavanshi opens up after record-breaking 204
stories.summary: Sooryavanshi registered the fastest century and double century in List A cricket, reaching the 100-run milestone in just 28 balls before completing his double hundred off 52 deliveries. Speaking after being named Player of the Match, Sooryavanshi explained that his approach was initially to spend time at the crease after failing to convert his starts in the previous two matches.

stories.title: World chess championship: Gritty Gukesh weathers time pressure, holds Sindarov
stories.summary: There was this man-against-machine match in chess in 1998. If you thought the machine might have won, you are wrong. The man, named Viswanathan Anand, beat Fritz. The computer had white pieces and it opted for the Spanish Game. Anand, who hadn’t yet won any of his World titles yet, played the Berlin Defence.

stories.title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi rewrites List A record books with 52-ball double ton as India A cruise into Asia Cup Rising Stars semis
stories.summary: India A will take on Sri Lanka A in the first semifinal of the Asia Cup Rising Stars to be held on Thursday at the West End Park International Stadium in Doha. The fixture was confirmed after Pakistan A’s 96-run win over Nepal in the Group B contest that resulted in former finishing at the top of the table, above India A.

stories.title: Russia accuses NATO member Estonia of hostile actions ‘on the verge of unleashing open war’
stories.summary: Russia's Foreign Ministry has lashed out at Estonia's government, accusing the NATO member of carrying out a range of "hostile actions" and putting the Baltic state "on the verge of unleashing open war" with Moscow. The outburst underscores rising tensions between Russia and countries on NATO's eastern flank and comes after Estonia announced it will close its road border crossings with Russia from Dec.

stories.title: AFC Champions League Two: East Bengal takes on Al-Hussein in a must-win tie
stories.summary: East Bengal FC faces a decisive test in its continental campaign as it hosts Jordan’s Al-Hussein SC at the Salt Lake Stadium in a Group D clash of the AFC Champions League Two on Tuesday. With qualification for the round of 16 hanging in the balance, the red and gold brigade approaches the penultimate round of the group stage knowing that a victory is essential to keep its hopes alive.

stories.title: ICC and India, Pakistan Boards must step in: Harbhajan on player behaviour
stories.summary: Harbhajan Singh has urged the International Cricket Council and the respective cricket Boards to rein in player behaviour after recent skirmishes between India and Pakistan at the under-19 and A levels. Reacting to the exchanges during India-A’s defeat to Pakistan-A in the Asia Cup Rising Stars in Doha on Sunday and under-19 Asia Cup final, Harbhajan felt that it set a bad example for youngsters.

stories.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Priyansh Arya breaks record, marks highest individual T20 score by an Indian
stories.summary: Delhi skipper Priyansh Arya rated his scintillating 68-ball 181 (7x4, 19x6) against Tamil Nadu in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) as the best innings of his career. Arya rewrote the record books, registering the highest individual T20 score by an Indian and equalling the record for the most sixes in a T20 innings, alongside Finn Allen.

stories.title: PT Usha out of IOA president's race, Gagan Narang, Virendra Sachdeva in fray
stories.summary: A relatively new-look Indian Olympic Association (IOA) is on the cards. On Tuesday, the final day of nominations, Olympic shooting medallist Gagan Narang and Archery Association of India secretary general Virendra Sachdeva filed their nominations for the post of IOA president. Former IOA secretary general Rajeev Mehta is also in the fray for the top post, making it a three-way contest.

stories.title: The Sooryavanshi phenomenon: 204 off 53 and a glimpse of cricket's future
stories.summary: Flat and hard… the sixes were already travelling 75-80 metres. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, barely 11 years old then, was still in the practice phase of his development when childhood coach Manish Ojha decided to test him against a group of senior players at his academy in 2022.

stories.title: 'Six maara kya?': Tilak reveals dugout's hilarious reaction to Sooryavanshi's carnage
stories.summary: India A captain Tilak Varma was left short of words after witnessing Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's breathtaking 204-run assault against the UAE in the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026. Sooryavanshi produced one of the most destructive batting performances in List A cricket, smashing 204 off just 53 deliveries, including seven fours and a record-breaking 28 sixes.

stories.title: ‘Shameful’: Harbhajan wants ICC, boards to curb India vs Pakistan on-field tiffs
stories.summary: Former spinner Harbhajan Singh on Tuesday called for the ICC and the respective cricket Boards to step in and curb the behaviour of India and Pakistan players during their matches, saying the reactions from both sides set a "shameful" example for the next generation.

stories.title: PWL Season 6 to be held in Delhi from January 3-19
stories.summary: The Pro Wrestling League (PWL) has announced the revised schedule for Season 6, which will now be held from January 3 to 19 at the KD Jadhav stadium here. Held under the aegis of the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI), PWL also announced that the player auction for the upcoming season will take place on November 30 in Mumbai.

stories.title: Priyansh Arya smashes 181, the second-highest score in T20 history
stories.summary: Priyansh Arya , the Delhi captain, on Tuesday, registered the highest individual score by an Indian batter in all T20s, his 181 surpassing KL Rahul's previous best of 152 for the Delhi Capitals against the Punjab Kings in the 2026 edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL).

stories.title: 54th International Emmys: Real Kashmir FC misses out, India returns without a win
stories.summary: The Indian series was up against the UK's A Thousand Blows , France's Careme and Argentina's Menem . It was Careme , an Apple TV production, that took home the award, leaving India without a win this year. While the result didn't go India's way, the nomination meant a lot to the team behind Real Kashmir Football Club .

stories.title: Asia Cup Rising Stars: UAE elects to bat against India ‘A’
stories.summary: United Arab Emirates won the toss and opted to bat against India in their final Group B match of the Asia Cup Rising Stars 50-over tournament here on Tuesday. India A have made three changes to the playing XI, bringing in Prabhsimran Singh, Harsh Dubey and Arshad Khan in place of Ayush Badoni, Vipraj Nigam and Prince Yadav.

stories.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Peerless Priyansh plunders a hapless Tamil Nadu attack
stories.summary: Delhi skipper Priyansh Arya registered the highest individual T20 score by an Indian, hammering a 68-ball 181 (7x4, 19x6) to power Delhi to 275 for five and a 116-run win over Tamil Nadu in Group B of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy at the Daly College ground here on Tuesday.

stories.title: Brandon Aiyuk scheduled to meet Commanders after 49ers release WR: Report
stories.summary: Brandon Aiyuk appears to be moving quickly toward his next NFL opportunity after being released by the San Francisco 49ers on Monday. The wide receiver is scheduled to meet with the Washington Commanders on Wednesday, according to the Associated Press. During the summer, Aiyuk suggested on social media that he would join Washington “Tomorrow” if San Francisco let him go.

stories.title: Is Hamilton and Leclerc's Ferrari partnership sustainable? F1 Q&A
stories.summary: Max Verstappen triumphed in a thrilling Las Vegas Grand Prix ahead of the McLarens of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri. There were 34 lead changes across the 50 laps of racing as Dutchman Verstappen held off attacks from Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and George Russell, plus his Red Bull team-mate Isack Hadjar.

stories.title: Indore Sports Roundup 2026: Tennis Duo Ends Nine-Year Gold Drought, City Athletes Shine In Judo, Wrestling And Snooker
stories.summary: Indore (Madhya Pradesh): Madhya Pradesh ended a nine-year wait for the men’s doubles tennis gold at the Deaf National Games after Divyalakshay Chauhan and Dhananjay Dubey clinched the title in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. The MP pair defeated defending champions Tamil Nadu in the final, reversing defeats suffered against the same opponents in 2023 and 2025.

stories.title: What does ₹1.25L monthly budget look like? ‘ ₹30,000 grocery, ₹20,000 grooming’: Noida couple’s expenses go viral
stories.summary: Owning a home does not always mean that monthly expenses are low. 25 lakh every month, even though they own their house and do not have to pay rent. The couple shared a video on Instagram explaining their monthly expenses. Their spending includes groceries, household help, gym memberships , grooming, food and travel.

stories.title: Why BJP is keen on renaming West Bengal ‘Paschim Banga’? | Explained
stories.summary: On November 23, 2026, West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said that the State will be referred to as ‘Paschim Banga’ in all languages including English. Mr. Adhikari said the State Cabinet had passed the proposal and a new resolution to the effect would be tabled in the Assembly on December 9.

stories.title: The price of no climate deal: After COP31, what's next for India and the world | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The United Nations (UN) climate summit in Antalya, COP31, ran two days over schedule and ended on November 22 without a cover decision, the overarching text that sums up what a summit achieved. As petrostates like Saudi Arabia and Russia pushed to omit fossil fuels from the final draft, the text was reluctantly accepted by many countries.

stories.title: Knowledge Nugget | EPFO’s new rules explained: From easier PF withdrawals to payout plan for retirees
stories.summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), at the meeting of its Central Board of Trustees (CBT) on November 19, 2026, approved key changes to Provident Fund (PF) withdrawal rules. These include reducing the waiting period for final PF settlement after unemployment from 12 months to two months, lowering the minimum balance that members must retain in their accounts from 25% to 10%, and introducing a Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP).

stories.title: Why is Apple’s NameDrop feature at centre of Rs 1500-crore lawsuit in India?
stories.summary: The lawsuit has been filed in Bombay High Court by US-based startup GG Technologies, which has alleged that Apple’s NameDrop feature infringes its patented technology. 86 million) in damages from Apple, according to a report by TechCrunch. It has also urged the court to issue an order blocking the imports of infringing Apple devices into India, along with restrictions on their sale.

stories.title: Explainer-Mexico nabs yet another top drug lord, but history of ‘Kingpin Strategy’ mixed
stories.summary: Chapo Isidro was considered one of the leaders of the Beltrán Leyva Organization, a former ally of the powerful Sinaloa Cartel that later became one of its top rivals. His capture is the latest in a string of arrests of high-profile suspected drug traffickers as Mexico — under intense pressure from US President Donald Trump — has decisively returned to the so-called Kingpin Strategy.

stories.title: Explainer-What are the disputes between Iraq’s federal government and Kurdistan region?
stories.summary: The orders are part of a broader crackdown by Zaidi against oil smuggling. They also reopen long-running disputes between Baghdad and the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) over control of oil, money, territory and trade. Though Baghdad says state oil marketer SOMO has sole authority to export Iraq’s crude, for years the KRG exported independently through a pipeline to Turkey’s Ceyhan port.

stories.title: 8th Pay Commission: Civilian defence staff seek 6% annual increment, OPS and 50% DA merger— 13 key demands explained
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Pratiraksha Mazdoor Sangh (BPMS), an all-India federation of civilian defence employees recognised by the Ministry of Defence, has submitted a fresh list of around 73 demands to the 8th Central Pay Commission (CPC), seeking substantial improvements in salaries, pensions and service benefits for central government employees, particularly defence civilian personnel.

stories.title: What do lemurs and opera singers share?
stories.summary: Have you seen opera performers sing? You might notice how their mouths move according to how high their pitch needs to be. Imagine finding out a primate in the rainforests of Madagascar has been doing the same, possibly even before opera began? With a pointy snout, large eyes and usually a long tail, you might have encountered this primate in one of your favourite movies, Madagascar.

stories.title: Year-round tax planning for salaried employees: a 12-month approach explained
stories.summary: By Archit GuptaEvery person’s personal finance rests on three things. The first is protecting yourself and your family through life and health insurance. The second is your home, and the loan that usually comes with it. The third is building wealth, turning your savings into a corpus that grows over time, whether that corpus is a retirement fund decades away or simply money set aside for a year-end holiday.

stories.title: Cases against Megaspeed, the Singapore firm tied to Jensen Huang’s brief ouster from Nvidia | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The US on Monday blacklisted Megaspeed International, the Singapore company whose former chief executive's affair with Jensen Huang led to his brief ouster from Nvidia , as an investigation continues into whether it moved the American firm's AI chips into China. Nvidia reinstated Huang the same day the US announced its decision.

stories.title: What lies beyond Wayanad’s misty mountains?
stories.summary: The path narrows between rows of dark-green coffee bushes. The low branches of pepper sag under tight clusters of unripe green cherries. Spiders hang their webs between the plants and along the poles. ,” says one visitor, ducking the hanging web, afraid to break it. Arun George, the owner of GP Ecotic Land, Coffee and Eco Tourism, in Kattikulam, Wayanad explains how a chemical spray would have cleared them away.

stories.title: Who is Sugandha Hiremath? Meet businesswoman at centre of Kalyani family’s ₹1 lakh crore ancestral wealth dispute
stories.summary: Sugandha Hiremath, sister of Bharat Forge chairman Baba Kalyani, is at the centre of a high-profile inheritance dispute involving the Kalyani family’s ancestral wealth , estimated at more than ₹ 1 lakh crore. The legal battle, which has dragged on across judicial forums, involves claims over family assets, properties and stakes in companies linked to the Pune-based industrial family.

stories.title: How many calories does an Indian body burn? This room may tell us
stories.summary: How many calories does your body burn while you sleep? Does an Indian diet trigger a different metabolic response from a Western diet? Why does one person gain weight despite eating seemingly little, while another stays lean despite eating more? And how much does a sedentary lifestyle change the body's energy requirements?

stories.title: How did Jensen Huang get his Nvidia CEO job back in just 11 days?
stories.summary: The board now says input from senior levels of the US government leaves it confident his return poses no national security risk. Huang still faces questions from Congress, a California subpoena and an inquiry inside Nvidia. The New York Times reported on October 29 that US officials had concluded Alice Huang, an executive at data-centre firm Megaspeed, was passing information to Beijing, and that she and Huang were close.

stories.title: Taxpayer sold Bitcoin worth ₹4.94 crore and disclosed it in ITR, yet faced a tax notice. Why? HC ruling explained
stories.summary: A taxpayer who disclosed Bitcoin transactions worth nearly ₹ 5 crore in his income tax return still faced reassessment proceedings after the Income Tax Department alleged that he had failed to report the cryptocurrency transactions. The dispute eventually reached the Gujarat High Court, which found that the department's allegation was based on an incorrect reading of the taxpayer's return.

stories.title: Can you play as Jason and Lucia together in GTA 6? Character-switching explained
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 gives players two protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, who share a story and work together as partners. But can players actually take control of both characters at the same time? The answer is yes and no. GTA 6 allows players to bring Jason and Lucia together for activities, missions and robberies, but they cannot directly control both characters simultaneously.
